## A010 ALARM CENTRAL LOCKING NOT WORKING  [939005377]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > A ALARM > A010 ALARM CENTRAL LOCKING NOT WORKING
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS, 3.2 JTS, 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939005377

When the alarm is switched on using the remote control, the system is activated correctly (acoustic/visual signalling and deterrent LED working), but the central locking system is not working.

> Note: The Body Computer Node, having received the alarm on/off command, sends the door closing/opening signal, via the B-CAN, to the driver's door node (which controls the driver's front door lock and the fuel flap lock) and to the passenger door node (which controls the front passenger door lock). The body computer node controls the closing/opening of the boot lid directly (depending on the settings for the operation of the boot lid).

|  |  | Test results |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | PRELIMINARY CHECK | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Using the mechanical key, check that the central locking system is working properly. | Move on to Step 1 | Central locking not working. | Continue with the diagnosis of the central locking system **See table P11 CENTRAL LOCKING / NOT WORKING WITH REMOTE CONTROL** |
| 1 | CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Connect the Examiner diagnostic equipment and check the following at the Body Computer Node: - no control units inactive; - no faulty control units; - no control unit with faulty B-CAN line. | Move on to Step 2 | Presence of faults. | Continue following the instructions for the diagnostic equipment. |
| 2 | CHECK ON CORRECT OPERATION | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Check that the fault is no longer present. | End of diagnosis. | The fault persists. | Replace the Body Computer Node Op. 5505A32 BODY COMPUTER - R.R [→939010966] |

## A015 ALARM RINGING WITHOUT A REASON  [939003559]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > A ALARM > A015 ALARM RINGING WITHOUT A REASON

With the alarm on the alarm cycles are set off without any apparent cause and without any attempts to break into the vehicle.

> Note: If it is not possible to stop the siren and deactivate the alarm using the remote control, simply activate the instrument panel by inserting the key in the key recognition device. The system can recognize the transponder and switch off the alarm system in this way.

|  |  | Results of the tests |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | PRELIMINARY CHECKS | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Check that there is not actually any instrusion in the passenger compartment like an insect that could set off the alarm by moving around or any moving object that could be detected by the ultrasound sensors. Check that the windows are properly shut, especially if there are strong winds. | Move on to Step 1 | Insect in the passenger compartment that is detected by the ultrasound sensors when it moves around | Remove the cause of the alarm |
| Vehicle windows open when there are strong winds | Close the windows |  |  |  |
| 1 | CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Connect the Examiner equipment to the diagnostic socket and check at the Body Computer Node for the presence of any errors in the alarm memory | Move on to Step 2 | Presence of errors | Proceed as instructed by the diagnostic tester |
| 2 | ANTI-LIFTING/ULTRASOUND PROTECTION CHECK | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Connect the diagnostic equipment to the diagnostic socket and check at the Body Computer Node in active diagnosis that the anti-lift/ultrasound sensors are working properly | Move on to Step 3 | Anti-lift/ultrasound sensor faulty | Replace the courtesy light module with built-in sensor Op. 5580E50 ANTITHEFT DEVICE VOLUMETRIC SENSOR R R FOLLOWING ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT CHECK [→939011105] |
| 3 | PERIPHERAL PROTECTION CHECK | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Connect the diagnostic equipment to the diagnostic socket and check at the Body Computer Node that the microswitches for the doors, bonnet and boot are working properly. In particular that there are not problems with the doors closed See Test 70C CHECK ON DOOR LOCK MICROSWITCHES [→939010337 70C CHECK ON DOOR LOCK MICROSWITCHES] | Move on to Step 4 |  |  |
| 4 | CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Connect the Examiner diagnostic equipment to the diagnostic socket and check the condition of the A-Bus serial line between the Body Computer Node and the siren at the Body Computer Node in active diagnosis See E7015 ALARM [→939011825] | Move on to Step 5 | Fault at A-BUS serial line | Repair the A-BUS serial line See E7015 ALARM [→939011825] |
| 5 | SIREN POWER SUPPLY CHECK | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Check that the siren power supply is correct and check the condition of the connections See E7015 ALARM [→939011825] | End of diagnosis | Siren power supply not correct | Restore the power supply See E7015 ALARM [→939011825] |
| Vehicle battery run down (voltage below 3 Volt) | Recharge the battery |  |  |  |
| Body Computer defective | Replace Body Computer Op. 5505A32 BODY COMPUTER - R.R [→939010966] |  |  |  |

## A020 ALARM SIREN NOT WORKING  [939003556]

> Note: The siren is connected to the Body Computer Node via the A-Bus dialogue line.The siren is operated and controlled by the Body Computer Node by means of a series of coded messages; in the case of a failure the Body Computer node detects and memorizes the causes of the malfunction.The siren is equipped with a battery whose charge is guaranteed in the presence of a +15 supply from the ignition with the alarm system switched off and is managed by the actual siren; the activation/end of charge command is given by the Body Computer

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |

| 2 | SIREN ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT CHECK | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Check that the power supply for the siren is correct and check the continuity and insulation for the A-BUS serial line between the Body Computer Node and the siren by carrying out the See Test 5580EB SIREN FUNCTIONAL TEST [→939010312 5580EB SIREN FUNCTIONAL TEST] | Move on to Step 3 |  |  |
| 3 | CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Connect the Examiner diagnostic equipment to the diagnostic socket and check the following at the Body Computer Node in parameters ambient . the correct activation of the siren . the condition of the A-Bus serial line | Move on to Step 4 | The siren is not activated | Replace the siren **See Test 5580E40 ANTI-THEFT DEVICE SIREN - R+R** |
| Serial line broken | Renew serial line See E7015 ALARM [→939011825] |  |  |  |
| 4 | CHECK ON CORRECT OPERATION | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Check that the fault is no longer present | End of diagnosis | The fault persists | Replace Body Computer Op. 5505A32 BODY COMPUTER - R.R [→939010966] |

## A025 ALARM VOLUMETRIC SURVEILLANCE NOT WORKING  [939003557]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > A ALARM > A025 ALARM VOLUMETRIC SURVEILLANCE NOT WORKING
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS, 3.2 JTS, 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939003557

When the alarm is switched on using the remote control, the system is activated correctly but the volumetric sensors do not intervene.

> Note: The volumetric sensors are located in the courtesy light module and are connected to the Body Computer Node via the dialogue line known as the A-BUS. The volumetric sensors are operated and controlled by the Body Computer node by means of a series of coded messages and can be excluded by the customer using the special button. If there is a failure the Body Computer Node detects and memorizes the causes of the malfunction

|  |  | Results of the tests |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Connect the diagnostic equipment to the diagnostic socket and check the following at the Body Computer Node in parameters ambient: . the presence of the volumetric sensors in the errors ambient: . that there are no faults with the volumetric sensors | Move on to Step 2 | Volumetric sensors manually excluded | Switch on the volumetric sensors after getting permission from the customer |
| Volumetric sensors not present | Check the conformity of the vehicle |  |  |  |
| Presence of faults | Proceed as instructed by the diagnostic tester |  |  |  |
| 2 | ULTRASOUND MODULE POWER SUPPLY CHECK | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Check that the ultrasound module is correctly supplied by carrying out the See Test 5580EC ULTRASOUND/ANTI-LIFT MODULE CHECK [→939010313 5580EC ULTRASOUND/ANTI-LIFT MODULE CHECK] | Move on to Step 3 | Supply not correct | Restore correct power supply |
| 3 | CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Connect the diagnostic equipment to the diagnostic socket and check the following at the Body Computer Node in active diagnosis: - the operation of the volumetric modules - the condition of the A-Bus serial line | Move on to Step 4 | A-BUS serial line interruption | Renew serial line See E7015 ALARM [→939011825] |
| Ultrasound module defective | Replace the courtesy light module with built in ultrasound sensors Op. 5580E50 ANTITHEFT DEVICE VOLUMETRIC SENSOR R R FOLLOWING ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT CHECK [→939011105] |  |  |  |
| 4 | CHECK ON CORRECT OPERATION | All OK | Problems encountered | Operation |
|  | Check that the fault is no longer present | Fault persists | Body Computer defective | Replace Body Computer Op. 5505A32 BODY COMPUTER - R.R [→939010966] |

## A035 TILT SENSOR ALARM NOT WORKING  [939003558]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > A ALARM > A035 TILT SENSOR ALARM NOT WORKING
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)

- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939003558

> Note: The anti-tilt sensor is located in the courtesy light module and is connected to the Body Computer by means of the dialogue line known as the A-BUS. The tilt sensor is operated and controlled by the Body Computer Node via a series of encrypted messages and can be excluded by the customer using the special button. If there is a failure the Body Computer Node detects and memorizes the causes of the malfunction

## D002 ENGINE NOT RUNNING SMOOTHLY / (LOSING POWER)  [939005387]

## K043 DISPLAY DOES NOT SHOW AVERAGE CONSUMPTION ON TRIP MODULE  [939003645]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > K INSTRUMENT PANEL > K043 DISPLAY DOES NOT SHOW AVERAGE CONSUMPTION ON TRIP MODULE
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- Applies to: all engines; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939003645

With the key ON, the fuel consumption gauge on the display (one of the displays on the TRIP COMPUTER module) is not operational.

**N.B**: The display provides two types of fuel consumption reading, instantaneous or average. The fuel consumption readings are processed by the instrument panel node on the basis of information received from the body computer node (mileage) and the engine control node (litre of fuel consumed) made availablet to the instrument panel node via the B-CAN and C-CAN networks respectively.

In the absence of speed information (from the Brake Node) or instantaneous fuel consumption data (from the Engine Control Node), the fuel consumption data will be replaced by the reading "----"

## K064 AIR BAG FAILURE WARNING LIGHT ON  [939003654]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > K INSTRUMENT PANEL > K064 AIR BAG FAILURE WARNING LIGHT ON
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)

The brake fluid warning light remains on with the handbrake released.

N.B.: The (negative) brake fluid level signal is sent by the sensor to the Body Computer Node which makes it available via the B-CAN to the Instrument Panel Node.

## K125 DISPLAY DOES NOT SHOW RANGE ON TRIP MODULE  [939003673]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > K INSTRUMENT PANEL > K125 DISPLAY DOES NOT SHOW RANGE ON TRIP MODULE
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- Applies to: all engines; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939003673

With the key ON, the range reading on the display (one of the displays on the TRIP COMPUTER module) is not operational.

> Note: The display shows the range processed by the instrument panel node on the basis of information received from the body computer node (distance and fuel level as a percentage) and from the engine management node (consumption) made available to the instrument panel node via the B-CAN and C-CAN networks respectively.This data is then weighed on the capacity of the tank, programmed at the end of the line.

In the absence of speed information (from the Brake Node) or instantaneous fuel consumption data (from the Engine Control Node) or fuel level (from the Body Computer), the range information will be replaced by the reading "----"

## K158 GENERAL FAILURE WARNING LIGHT NOT WORKING  [939003686]

Even if one of the functions signalled by the general failure warning light is faulty, the warning light in the instrument panel does not come on

N.B: The following functions cause the activation of the general failure warning light:

- Inertia switch (FIS) operation
- Speed limit exceeded
- Diesel filter sensor failure (JTD only)
- Engine oil pressure sensor failure
- Rain sensor failure (if fitted)
- Parking sensor failure (if fitted)
- Dusk sensor failure (if fitted)
- Window anti-crush safety system failure (HIGH version only)
- Speedometer signal failure
- Tyre inflation pressure sensor failure

## L026 ELECTRIC AIR PREHEATING IS NOT ACTIVATED WITH LOW EXTERNAL TEMPERATURE  [939003707]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > L CLIMATE CONTROL > L026 ELECTRIC AIR PREHEATING IS NOT ACTIVATED WITH LOW EXTERNAL TEMPERATURE
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- Applies to: all engines; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939003707

> Block applies to: all engines; all production periods; only with equipment: Automatic Air Conditioning
The outside temperature information is correctly displayed on the reconfigurable matrix.

> Block applies to: all engines; all production periods; only with equipment: Automatic Air Conditioning
> Note: The electrical pre-heating device (only fitted on the JTD versions) consists of two (PTC) resistances with different resistance values which develop a maximum power of 900 W when a current passes through; when one of the two resistances or both of them are activated, the control unit is capable of modulating the heating.

> Block applies to: all engines; all production periods; only with equipment: Automatic Air Conditioning
The system can only be activated in the following circumstances:

> Block applies to: all engines; all production periods; only with equipment: Automatic Air Conditioning
- Ignition on and climate control switched on;
- Outside temperature below 20° C;
- Engine coolant temperature below 64° C;
- Battery voltage more than 12.2 V or more than 12.6 V (if only the less powerful section of the resistances is activated)
- Engine rpm higher than 700 rpm
- Driver's temperature below the passenger compartment sensor temperature.

> Block applies to: all engines; all production periods; only with equipment: Automatic Air Conditioning
| 0 | PRELIMINARY CHECKS | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | Connect the Examiner diagnostic equipment and check the following at the Body Computer Node: that the Logistic Mode function is deactivated (with this function activated the operation of the PTC resistances is disabled). | Move on to Step 1 | Logistic Mode function activated. | Deactivate the Logistic Mode function. |
| 1 | CHECK ON CONDITION OF FUSES | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check the condition of the protective fuses for the air pre-heating supply system (eletrical). | Move on to Step 2 | Fuse burnt out. | Replace the fuse burnt out (and find out what could have caused it to blow). |
| 2 | CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Connect the Examiner diagnostic equipment and check that there is no error at relays J036 and J037 operating the PTC devices. | Move on to Step 3 | Relay damaged. | Replace the damaged relay(s). |
| 3 | CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Keeping the Examiner diagnostic equipment connected, check in the active diagnosis ambient at the Climate Control Node that the two PTC resistances are working properly. | End of diagnosis | Malfunction of the two resistances (PTC). | Move on to Step 4. |
| 4 | ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT CHECK | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check that: the electrical connectors are correctly inserted in their housings in the devices; continuity/insulation of the electrical connection between the Climate Control Node, the operating relays and the resistances (PTC); power supply signal to the resistances (PTC). | Move on to Step 5 | 1.Electrical connectors incorrectly connected. | 1.Connect the electrical connectors correctly in their housings. |

## N079 PARKING DEVICE NOT WORKING  [939003726]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > N RADIO AND ACCESSORIES ETC.. > N079 PARKING DEVICE NOT WORKING
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- Applies to: all engines; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939003726

The following message appears on the control panel: driving aid not available

The ultrasound distance detection system for parking provides the driver with information on distance while approaching obstacles behind or in front of the car (only 8 channel version).

The information of the presence/distance of an obstacle is transmitted to the driver by means of acoustic warnings whose frequency depends on the distance of the obstacle.

The distance measurement only takes place when the system is activated, whilst only the control unit microcontroller is operational in the inactive state.

> Note: the 4 channel system is activated at the key ON with reverse gear engaged whilst the 8 channel system is activated at the key ON, with reverse gear engaged, the LED in the parking sensors activation button on and the vehicle speed below 15 Km/h. The parking sensor node receives the reversing signal from the Body Computer node via the CAN line

## P010 CENTRAL LOCKING NOT WORKING  [939003733]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > P DOORS > P010 CENTRAL LOCKING NOT WORKING
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- Applies to: all engines; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939003733

When the central locking is operated via the driver's door using the mechanical insert and/or from the inside, via the locking/unlocking buttons, the central locking system does not work. The deterrent LED in the driver's door panel signals that the locking has taken place. The locking will only be carried out if all the doors are properly shut. The inhibition of the locking is signalled by an LED in the door panel flashing quickly for 3 seconds.

> Block applies to: engines: 3.2 JTS; all production periods
There is slight knocking that usually gets worse during acceleration. The engine produces a dry noise typical of metallic knocking which changes when the throttle opens.

> Block applies to: engines: 3.2 JTS; all production periods
> Note: Make sure that the knocking is not noticeable when the road surface changes. The latter can cause a change in the engine torque transmitted to the rear wheels which could also lead to engine detonation.

## S015 NOISE WHILST DRIVING  [939007871]

Whilst driving, especially on unmade roads, there is an unspecific noise.

> Note: This noise could be due to the engine assembly, the clutch-gearbox-differential unit or the braking system. In these cases the noise could also occur on even road surfaces or only in certain gears or certain conditions (gear engagement/release, braking, etc.)

## Y001 P0016 - TIMING/RPM SYNCHRONISATION  [939005135]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > Y EXAMINER - DIESEL ELECTRONIC MANAGEMENT > Y001 P0016 - TIMING/RPM SYNCHRONISATION
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939005135

The diagnostic equipment signals: Error P0016 (Timing/rpm synchronization)

> Note: This error is detected if the engine speed is above 50 rpm, the control module does not recognize any camshaft signal or the signal is not plausible. The above conditions should be satisfied for at least 0.8 secs.

| 1 | Engine speed check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | Check that the engine speed is correct by carrying out the test See Test 1060GI ENGINE SPEED CHECK [→939010190 1060GI ENGINE SPEED CHECK] | Move on to Step 2 |  |  |
| 2 | Check on correct engine timing | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check that the engine speed is correct by carrying out the test Op. 0510A20 TIMING GEAR WITH BELT DRIVE - CHECK - CARRY OUT OPERATION WITH CAM COVER(S) REMOVED AND TAPPETS ADJUSTED AND CRANKSHAFT PULLEY DETACHED (IF NECESSARY) [→939010388] | Move on to Step 3 | Timing not correct | Restore the correct engine timing Op. 1032B10 TOOTHED TIMING BELT - R + R FOR TIMING ADJUSTMENT OR REPLACEMENT [→939010458] |
| 3 | Timing sensor check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check correct operation of the timing sensor by carrying out the test See Test 5510CG CHECK TIMING SENSOR OPERATION [→939010331 5510CG CHECK TIMING SENSOR OPERATION] | End of diagnosis |  |  |

## Y002 P0087 - PRESSURE ON FLUTE  [939005136]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > Y EXAMINER - DIESEL ELECTRONIC MANAGEMENT > Y002 P0087 - PRESSURE ON FLUTE
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)

- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939005136

The diagnostic equipment signals: Error P0087 (Pressure at pipe)

> Note: This error is detected if the pressure measured is too low. As a result, the engine is switched off.

| 0 | Preliminary checks | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | The fuel system is highly sensitive. The work must be carried out with the greatest cleanliness and care. Any air in the system could damage the high pressure fuel pump. The vehicle must therefore never be driven with the fuel tank empty. Check that the tank contains the correct type of fuel. The fuel reserve should be more than 5 litres. Check that there are no leaks from the fuel system. Check the hoses and pipes connected to identify any obstructions, damage, etc. Check that the connectors and seals are correctly fitted. | Move on to Step 1 | 1.The tank contains irregular substances (petrol, other fluids) | 1.Clean the tank and refill it correctly |
| 2.There are less than 5 litres in the tank | 2.Top up the fuel level to more than 5 litres |  |  |  |
| 3.Fuel system leaking or not correctly sealed | 3.Renew the seal for the system. If necessary, replace the faulty components |  |  |  |
| 4.Pipes obstructed or damaged | 4.Renew the pipes. If necessary, replace the faulty components |  |  |  |
| 1 | High pressure check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check that the diesel pressure parameter is correct as described in the test. See Test 1060OD INSPECTION OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT [→939010206 1060OD INSPECTION OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT] | Move on to Step 12 | Pressure not correct | Move on to Step 2 |
| 2 | Injector high pressure check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check, as described in the test, that the diesel leaks from the injector recirculation connections are small (seepage) and roughly equal to one another. See Test 1060OC INJECTORS SEAL TEST [→939010205 1060OC INJECTORS SEAL TEST] | Move on to Step 3 | Significant leak from one injector | Replace the injector |
| 3 | Low return pressure check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check, as described in the test, that the pressure in the return pipe to the tank is less than 1 bar See Test 1060OA CHECK ON RETURN LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT [→939010203 1060OA CHECK ON RETURN LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT] | Move on to Step 4 | Pressure above the maximum limit: return pipe to the tank obstructed | Repair the pipe, if necessary, replace it |
| 4 | Low supply pressure check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check, as described in the test, that the diesel pressure between the filter and the pressure pump is between 2 and 3 bar See Test 1060OB CHECK ON SUPPLY LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT [→939010204 1060OB CHECK ON SUPPLY LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT] | Move on to Step 10 | Pressure below the minimum limit or above the maximum limit | Move on to Step 5 |
| 5 | Low supply pressure check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Constrict the return pipe, downstream of the valve, and carry out the test again with the pipe constricted checking that the pressure at the filter outlet stays below 2 bar See Test 1060OB CHECK ON SUPPLY LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT [→939010204 1060OB CHECK ON SUPPLY LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT] | Move on to Step 6 | Pressure rises to 5 bar: pressure regulator valve on filter mounting incorrectly adjusted | Replace the valve **Op. 1044B16** |
| 6 | Low supply pressure check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check that the difference in pressure upstream and downstream of the filter is less than 1 bar | Move on to Step 7 | Difference in pressure more than 1 bar | Replace the fuel filter cartridge **Op. 1044B20** |
| 7 | Low supply pressure check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check that the supply pump pressure at the filter inlet is more than 2.2 bar | Move on to Step 10 | Pressure below 2.2 bar | Move on to Step 8 |
| 8 | Low supply pressure check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Measure the difference in pressure between the electric pump outlet and the filter inlet and check that it is less than 0.3 bar | Move on to Step 9 | Difference in pressure more than 0.3 bar | Replace the pipe |
| 9 | Low supply pressure check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check, as described in the test, that the pump supply voltage is equal to 12 V and that the current uptake is between 2 and 10 A See Test 1040AA SUPPLY VOLTAGE AND ABSORPTION CURRENT CHECKS [→939010174 1040AA SUPPLY VOLTAGE AND ABSORPTION CURRENT CHECKS] | Move on to Step 10 | 1.Voltage lower than 12 V | 1.Renew electrical wiring See E5050 DIESEL ENGINES ELECTRONIC MANAGEMENT [→939003133] |
| 2.Current greater than 10 A: pump defective | 2.Replace the fuel pump Op. 1040A70 SUBMERGED PUMP ASSEMBLY COMPLETE WITH LEVEL GAUGE CONTROL - R + R [→939010496] |  |  |  |
| 3.Current less than 2 A: pump obstructed | 3.Replace the fuel pump and clean the fuel tank Op. 1040A70 SUBMERGED PUMP ASSEMBLY COMPLETE WITH LEVEL GAUGE CONTROL - R + R [→939010496] |  |  |  |
| 10 | Correct operation check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Replace the DRV high pressure regulating valve Op. 1060E50 PRESSURE REGULATOR ON PRESSURE PUMP - R.R. [→939010552] and check that the fault is no longer present. | End of diagnosis | The fault persists | Move on to Step 11 |
| 11 | Correct operation check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Replace the pressure pump Op. 1060E10 DIESEL INJECTION PRESSURE PUMP - R.R. [→939010549] and check that the fault is no longer present | End of diagnosis | The fault persists | Contact technical service for further information on the problem |
| 12 | Fuel pump relay active diganosis | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Carry out the active diagnosis of the fuel pump relay using the diagnostic equipment checking that the result is positive | Move on to Step 13 | The active diagnosis not successful | Carry out the test See Test 1040AB SUBMERGED FUEL PUMP CHECK [→939010176 1040AB SUBMERGED FUEL PUMP CHECK] |
| 13 | Pressure regulator replacement | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Replace the fuel pressure regulator Op. 1060E50 PRESSURE REGULATOR ON PRESSURE PUMP - R.R. [→939010552] and check the fault has disappeared | Move on to Step 14 | The fault persists | Renew the pressure regulator and replace the flow valve **Op. 1060E20 FUEL -R.R. CUT-OFF SOLENOID VALVE** |
| 14 | Correct operation check | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Replace the engine management control unit Op. 1060G80 DIESEL ELECTRONIC INJECTION CONTROL UNIT - .R [→939010573] and check that the fault is no longer present | End of diagnosis | The fault persists | Contact technical service for further information on the problem |

|  | Check that the diesel pressure parameter is correct. See Test 1060OD INSPECTION OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT [→939010206 1060OD INSPECTION OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT] | Move on to Step 13 | Pressure not correct | Move on to Step 3 |
| 3 | INJECTOR HIGH PRESSURE CHECK | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check that the diesel leaks from the injector recirculation connections are small (seepage) and roughly equal to one another. See Test 1060OC INJECTORS SEAL TEST [→939010205 1060OC INJECTORS SEAL TEST] | Move on to Step 4 | Significant leak from one injector | Replace the injector |
| 4 | LOW RETURN PRESSURE CHECK | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check that the pressure in the return pipe to the tank is less than 1 bar See Test 1060OA CHECK ON RETURN LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT [→939010203 1060OA CHECK ON RETURN LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT] | Move on to Step 5 | Pressure above the maximum limit: return pipe to the tank obstructed | Repair the pipe, if necessary, replace it |
| 5 | LOW SUPPLY PRESSURE CHECK | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check that the diesel pressure between the filter and the pressure pump is between 2 and 3 bar See Test 1060OB CHECK ON SUPPLY LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT [→939010204 1060OB CHECK ON SUPPLY LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT] | Move on to Step 11 | Pressure below the minimum limit or above the maximum limit | Move on to Step 6 |
| 6 | LOW SUPPLY PRESSURE CHECK | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Constrict the return pipe downstream of the valve and carry out the test again See Test 1060OB CHECK ON SUPPLY LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT [→939010204 1060OB CHECK ON SUPPLY LOW PRESSURE FUEL CIRCUIT] with the pipe constricted checking that the pressure at the filter outlet remains below 2 bar | Move on to Step 7 | Pressure rises to 5 bar: pressure regulator valve on filter mounting incorrectly adjusted | Replace the valve **Op. 1044B16** |
| 7 | LOW SUPPLY PRESSURE CHECK | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check that the difference in pressure upstream and downstream of the filter is less than 1 bar | Move on to Step 8 | Difference in pressure more than 1 bar | Replace the fuel filter cartridge **Op. 1044B20** |
| 8 | LOW SUPPLY PRESSURE CHECK | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check that the supply pump pressure at the filter inlet is more than 2.2 bar | Move on to Step 11 | Pressure below 2.2 bar | Move on to Step 9 |
| 9 | LOW SUPPLY PRESSURE CHECK | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Measure the difference in pressure between the electric pump outlet and the filter inlet and check that it is less than 0.3 bar | Move on to Step 10 | Difference in pressure more than 0.3 bar | Replace the pipe |
| 10 | LOW SUPPLY PRESSURE CHECK | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Check that the pump supply voltage is equal to 12V and that the current uptake is between 2 and 10 A See Test 1040AA SUPPLY VOLTAGE AND ABSORPTION CURRENT CHECKS [→939010174 1040AA SUPPLY VOLTAGE AND ABSORPTION CURRENT CHECKS] | Move on to Step 11 | 1. Voltage lower than 12 V | 1. Renew electrical wiring See E5050 DIESEL ENGINES ELECTRONIC MANAGEMENT [→939003133] |
| 2. Current greater than 10 A: pump defective | 2. Replace the fuel pump |  |  |  |
| 3. Current less than 2 A: pump obstructed | 3. Replace the fuel pump and clean the fuel tank |  |  |  |
| 11 | CHECK ON CORRECT OPERATION | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Replace the DRV high pressure regulation valve and check that the fault is no longer present. Op. 1060E50 PRESSURE REGULATOR ON PRESSURE PUMP - R.R. [→939010552] | End of diagnosis | The fault persists | Move on to Step 12 |
| 12 | CHECK ON CORRECT OPERATION | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Replace the pressure pump and check that the fault is no longer present Op. 1060E10 DIESEL INJECTION PRESSURE PUMP - R.R. [→939010549] | End of diagnosis | The fault persists | Contact the Service Department for further information on the problem |
| 13 | PRESSURE REGULATOR REPLACEMENT | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
|  | Replace the fuel pressure regulator and check that the problem disappears Op. 1060E50 PRESSURE REGULATOR ON PRESSURE PUMP - R.R. [→939010552] | Move on to Step 14 | The fault persists | Renew the pressure regulator and replace the flow valve **Op. 1060E20** |

## Y106 P0778 - FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR (HIGH PRESSURE PUMP OR FLUTE OUTLET)  [939005226]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > Y EXAMINER - DIESEL ELECTRONIC MANAGEMENT > Y106 P0778 - FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR (HIGH PRESSURE PUMP OR FLUTE OUTLET)
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939005226

The diagnostic equipment signals: Error P0778 (fuel pressure regulator (high pressure pump outlet or pipe).

> Note: This error is detected if there is a break in the circuit connected to Pins 4 and 34 of the control unit for at least 0.28 secs. (detail "open circuit"), if there is a short circuit to positive in the circuit connected to Pin 34 of the control unit for at least 0.28 secs (detail "short circuit to +Vbatt"), if there is a short circuit to earth in the circuit connected to Pin 34 of the control unit for at least 0.22 secs. (detail "short circuit to earth") or if the temperature of the electronic control module measured is not within the limits for at least 0.28 secs (detail "excessive temperature").

| 1 | Check on operation of fuel pressure regulator on the rail | ALL OK | PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED | ACTION |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | Check that the fuel pressure regulator on the rail is working properly by carrying out the test See Test 1060GR CHECK OPERATION OF FUEL PRESSURE SENSOR ON RAIL [→939010198 1060GR CHECK OPERATION OF FUEL PRESSURE SENSOR ON RAIL] | End of diagnosis |  |  |

## Y108 P2293 - FUEL PRESSURE (HIGH PRESSURE PUMP OR FLUTE INPUT ADJUSTMENT)  [939005228]
- Path: Fault diagnosis > Y EXAMINER - DIESEL ELECTRONIC MANAGEMENT > Y108 P2293 - FUEL PRESSURE (HIGH PRESSURE PUMP OR FLUTE INPUT ADJUSTMENT)
- Kind: fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939005228

The diagnostic equipment signals: Error P2293 (fuel pressure regulator (high pressure pump inlet or pipe).
